name: Udemy Business
description: Udemy Business MCP brings our comprehensive AI-powered skills development platform directly into your AI tools. Employees discover and access expertly curated courses via personalized search and recommendations. This enables just-in-time learning in the flow of work with enterprise-grade security and scalability.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Udemy Business to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Udemy Business to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.udemy.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Udemy Business MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Udemy Business provides these MCP tools: search_courses, search_learning_paths, search_lectures, search_labs, and get_course_curriculum.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Udemy Business?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Udemy Business in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Udemy Business MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Udemy Business requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Udemy Business is developed by Udemy, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
